stories.title: Sign-offs made void by a later decision; a column added to the ledger, the map still fits

book.note: Bank account balance per general ledger
Bank account balance per general ledger

stories.recipe: Sage-style ledger by caxlsx, typed voucher numbers and dates shown dd/mm/yyyy. February: a payment the bank takes 0.03 above the book and a receipt it credits 0.02 below, both tolerated under 0.05 an item and 0.10 a period; a payment booked six days early, accepted; a lodgement in transit and a service charge not booked. The sheet is prepared and reviewed, then the reviewer has the 0.03 payment rejected: both sign-offs no longer stand, and both members are carried. March: the export gains a Reconciled column at its end, so the saved map still fits; no tolerance is declared; the lodgement arrives and the charge is booked, both carried cases accepted; two payments booked five days early accepted together; a 0.01 receipt difference rejected. February's tolerated 0.02, never booked, is still between bank and book.

stories.title: Arabic: differences rejected as a group and carried; a cheque presented within the new per-item limit, which no tolerance reaches

book.note: رصيد حساب البنك في دفتر الأستاذ
رصيد حساب البنك في دفتر الأستاذ

stories.recipe: Arabic, Latin digits; ledger by OpenSpout with typed dates and #,##0.00 amounts, its strings inline. March, no tolerance: two payments the bank takes 0.05 and 0.02 above the book, rejected together from the queue, and a receipt it credits 0.04 below, rejected alone; a cheque of 2,350.00 issued. April, 0.02 an item and 0.05 a period: the cheque is presented for 2,350.02, a carried case whose difference the new limit would cover were it the month's own: rejected; a receipt 0.01 above and a payment 0.02 above the book, tolerated; a bill paid in two transfers and booked once, a duplicate reference rejected. The March members stay carried.

stories.title: The header moves down a row; two deposits in transit claim the same deposits together

book.note: Bank account balance per general ledger
Bank account balance per general ledger

stories.recipe: Odoo-style journal by caxlsx under three title rows, dates as text. April: two direct debits booked under other references, suggested by amount and date and accepted together; a tender payment booked four days early, accepted; two cash deposits of 800.00 booked on the last two days, not yet on the statement. May: the export prints one more title row, so the saved map does not fit and the columns are chosen again under the new header; the bank credits two deposits of 800.00 without a reference, which both carried deposits claim together: a carried ambiguity, rejected; 0.01 an item and a period: a 0.01 difference tolerated, a 0.02 one past the item limit rejected.

stories.title: A case settled by a policy declared after a save; a month refused as previous, then a second month in draft

stories.recipe: QuickBooks-style report by OpenSpout under four title rows, typed dates shown mm/dd/yyyy. May: a remittance the bank credits 0.02 above the book; saved with it undecided and no policy, a draft; then 0.02 an item and a period is declared, before any decision, and the case is tolerated; credit interest of 12.34 not yet booked. June, taken first on the undecided May session: refused as undecided, the sheet with it; then on the decided one: saved in draft while the booked interest and a 0.01 payment difference wait (no policy in June), then the interest's carried case accepted and the difference rejected. May's tolerated 0.02 is still between bank and book.

stories.title: Arabic, Arabic-Indic digits, three pages: the period limit met exactly, then exceeded; a column renamed

book.note: رصيد حساب البنك في دفتر الأستاذ
Bank account balance per general ledger

stories.recipe: Arabic, Arabic-Indic digits, three pages a month; ledger by caxlsx with Arabic voucher letters, dates as text and payments before receipts. June, 0.01 an item and 0.04 a period: four differences of 0.01 meet the period limit exactly and are tolerated; two payments booked seven days early, rejected together; a cheque of 4,200.00 issued. July: the reference column is renamed, so the saved map does not fit and the columns are chosen again; 0.01 an item and 0.02 a period: three differences of 0.01 pass the period limit, none is tolerated, two payments rejected together and a receipt alone; the cheque is presented and its carried case accepted; the sheet in English, prepared only. June's tolerated differences, never booked, remain between bank and book.

stories.title: A book balance declared wrongly in the first month only; carried items cleared by amount

book.note: Bank account balance per general ledger
Bank account balance per general ledger

stories.recipe: Xero-style account transactions by OpenSpout under four title rows, typed dates; two pages a month. January: two card settlements of 640.00 a day apart against one receipt of 640.00, an ambiguity by amount and date, rejected; a payment booked four days early, accepted; a service charge not booked and a cheque deposited without a reference, not yet credited; the book balance declared 100.00 below the book, an unexplained difference. February, the same export and the saved map: the charge booked without a reference and the cheque credited under one, each a carried suggestion by amount, accepted; 0.03 an item and a period: a 0.03 difference tolerated at the limit; the book balance declared right.
